# Stationary street artwork

Created with the built-in image-generation tool, then resized and optimized to WebP. Existing sponsor logos remain separate, unchanged artwork. The complete scene combines a static courtyard, sixteen static painted shopfronts, live logo/name boards, and the two moving friends. No shop, board, background or camera receives scroll transforms.

## painted-shop.webp

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent cutout for a miniature Gujarati Navratri storybook street. One complete charming old Ahmedabad wooden shopfront, frontal view from slightly above, isolated, no ground plane or background. Hand-painted anime watercolor gouache quality with warm golden lanterns, marigold garlands, richly carved wooden facade, teal canvas awning, inviting golden-lit display window and open door, tiny potted green plants flanking steps. A very broad EMPTY ivory rectangular signboard with wooden frame occupies the upper 45 percent of the building; leave its interior fully blank for real sponsor logos added in code. The roof is a thin carved cornice. Building proportions wide and low, approximately 3:2 width:height. Straight rectangular signboard, no perspective skew. All shop parts including steps fit fully inside image with small transparent margin. NO people, NO lettering, NO logos, NO symbols. Transparent background.

## friends-sidewalk.webp

Reference: the project's original `friends-walking.webp`.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this exact pair of illustrated Gujarati friends into a side-on walking pose travelling toward the RIGHT. Preserve their youthful chibi anime proportions, the man's short wavy dark hair, green gold embroidered kediyu and cream trousers, and the woman's long dark braid, pink-and-gold embroidered chaniya choli with green dupatta. They are still holding hands, looking along the street in the same direction, full body mid-step. Three-quarter side/back angle so their clothing and hairstyles are recognizable without changing identity. Keep both people completely visible, no extra people. Isolated cutout, genuinely transparent background with no scenery, no rectangular backdrop and no text. Match the supplied painted rendering.

## market-courtyard.webp

Use case: illustration-story. Background for a complete miniature Gujarati Navratri market-street diorama, landscape 1536x1024. High overhead view, near top-down. The central 85% is unobstructed warm weathered sandstone and small cobblestone paving, subtly textured, softly lit by amber lanterns. At the very outer edges only: leafy old trees, lush potted plants, marigold flower garlands, tiny brass oil lamps, decorative Gujarati carved low garden walls, warm festoon lights crossing near the very top edge. Hand-painted anime storybook watercolor/gouache style, rich teal and ochre night palette. Calm intimate celebratory late-night atmosphere. Layout will have sixteen separately composited shop buildings, so keep ALL central space clear and uniformly paved. No buildings in the middle, no central centerpiece, no people, no text, no logos. No vanishing point: overhead scene, not a street receding into distance.
